name: Working Title
source:
Working Title follows a pianist named Sylvia as she prepares for her university’s talent show. However, what should be a simple piano recital quickly turns into something darker as a mysterious presence seems to be haunting her, and she is forced to confront the sinister, horrific truth behind what she once believed to be her very ordinary life.

[From [url=https://barbieronpa.itch.io/working-title]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《工作标题》讲述了一位名叫西尔维娅的钢琴家为大学才艺表演做准备的故事。然而，一场简单的钢琴演奏会很快变得更加黑暗，因为有一种神秘的存在似乎困扰着她，她被迫面对她曾经认为非常平凡的生活背后的险恶、可怕的真相。

[来自[url=https://barbieronpa.itch.io/working-title]itch.io[/url]]
